SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, PO_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'IJST') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.CATEGORY_ID AS ITEM_CODE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.ITEM_AMT, A.RD_DATE, A.MAKER_CODE, A.MAKER_NAME, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.REF_PR_NO, A.REMARK, A.PLANT, A.BUDGET_DEPT AS BUDGET_DEPT_CODE, A.ADD_USER_DEPT AS REQUEST_DEPT_CODE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.LEGACY_USER_ID AS EMPLOYEE_NUMBER FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'T', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = 'PODT SEND ERROR' WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
